Interface EffectVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
RegistrationVisitor
public interface EffectVisitor
Visitor interface used to register BuildingEffect implementations with the correct game-level observer list.

Each concrete building effect implements BuildingEffect.accept(EffectVisitor) and calls the appropriate visit* method, which RegistrationVisitor then uses to attach the effect to the right observer list.
